Lisbon Airport is connected to the Metro; the airport publishes about 20 minutes to Saldanha. The 60-minute planning allowance includes city interchange/luggage margin. 2026 Carris/Metro single fare is €1.90; no advance reservation is required.

movements.notes: Avanti publishes direct London Euston–Holyhead journeys in as little as 3h47 and Advance fares from £39.50. €46 is a rounded planning conversion using the late-September 2026 GBP/EUR reference range; the fare is dynamic. Advance purchase is recommended but not a universal mandatory reservation.

Dublin Express publishes city-to-airport services with fares from €9. A representative George's Quay–Terminal 2 trip is about 52 minutes; 60 minutes is used as the planning allowance. Tickets can be bought on the day subject to availability, so advance booking is recommended rather than mandatory.
